explanation: Relational division is used when you need entities that are related to every member of a specified set. Supplying every item on a required list is the classic fit for that pattern.

options.text: Which customers bought at least one product last month?
Which suppliers provide every item on a required product list?
Which employees and departments should be combined into one report?
Which orders should be displayed in ascending date order?

prompt: Which business question is most naturally answered with relational division?
